claims.text: Google acquired the cloud-security firm Wiz for approximately $32 billion in an all-cash deal, a transaction announced on March 18, 2025 [Source: ev-1].
This acquisition was driven by Google Cloud’s strategy to close the security gap with competitors AWS and Azure [Source: ev-1].
By pursuing Wiz, Google bet that cloud-security consolidation would become the next battleground in the "cloud wars," leveraging AI-driven cloud adoption as a key demand driver [Source: ev-1].
The deal signaled this strategic shift toward securing market position through integrated security solutions. [Source: ev-1]
The transaction represented the largest acquisition in Google's history [Source: ev-1].
It followed a period of negotiation where Wiz had previously rejected an earlier $23 billion offer from Google in July 2024 [Source: ev-1].
Although announced in March 2025, the deal officially closed after shareholder and regulatory steps were completed, with completion reported in July 2025 [Source: ev-1].
